wizard.step1_desc: First, choose the CAPTCHA mechanism to use.
wizard.step2_desc:
Next, set up or create the "unverified member" role.
Members with this role are usually restricted until they verify.
wizard.step3_desc: Configure whether to automatically grant the unverified role when a member joins, and the trigger conditions.
wizard.step4_desc:
Finally, configure how verification prompts are sent.
For channel notifications, a persistent verification embed will be sent to that channel.
